name: 2029-2035 Indiana Avenue — First Presbyterian Church (district draft; refined by T-3014)

function.note: The 1911 sheet letters the building '1st PRESBYN. CHURCH'. No 1904 source for it is in hand, so the 1904 function is inferred from the 1911 label: a masonry church of this size, with a 90 ft spire, is not one put up in the seven years to 1911 without a trace in the study (T-3014 sources it).

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-3009, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-3014 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the rules' site row (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-district-background-3009). The church fills the 2029-2035 lot on Indiana Avenue at 21st Street, 48 ft to its eaves with a slated spire 90 ft high on its south-west tower, as Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 35 prints it; no photograph, drawing or 1904 record of it is in the repository yet. It is drafted from the T-3009 trace's measures, as a site so that its storeys, roof and tower are the sheet's printed heights and not a house's.

documented_range.note: No source dates the building; the draft claims the 1904 target on the 1911 sheet alone (study ruling 11).

position.symbolic_location: 2029-2035 S. Indiana Avenue, the north-east corner of Indiana Avenue and East Twenty-first Street, on sheet 35's Indiana frontage.
position.note: The rear corner of the main body (u -43.700, v -27.890 m from the building's front and southernmost faces), set from the corner at local (1282.70, -3598.28): Indiana Avenue's measured east line (data/street_grid/1904.json) with its centre 10.06 m (66 ft) west of it; the church's front stands 2.97 m behind that line and its south face 0.14 m behind 21st Street's north line, the trace's own readings. Good to about the trace's 0.19 m pixel and the sheet's fit. Rotation 179.497 degrees squares the plan to the avenue.

derivation.reason: The four derivation methods re-derive from the 1835 files; this position is re-derived from the 1904 street grid's faces and the rules' site row by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py --check instead.

footprint.note: The building's whole plan as the trace outlines it: the body with its buttresses, and the tower and porch block that steps south of it at the 21st Street corner; the main body (43.7 x 23.1 m) is draft_plan's first rectangle.

stories.note: Three draft storeys of 4.6 m over a 0.9 m floor stand the walls to 14.7 m, the sheet's printed 48 ft to the eaves; a church has no storeys, and the count only sets the wall height and the rows of openings.

construction.note: Brick: the sheet colours it pink.

parts.from: the church's body, buttresses included, as sheet 35 draws it under its dashed hips (the T-3009 trace of sheet 35 (s35wfp-indiana_2029-b1), read in metres from Indiana Avenue's east line and East 21st Street's north line)

draft_plan.note: One rectangle, the body read off the trace in metres from Indiana's line and 21st Street's; the buttresses fold into it and the tower stands as a feature.

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the site row: A hip at 40 degrees over the body, which the sheet draws with dashed hips. The tower is the sheet's three-storey square at the south-west corner, about 5.5 m across on the trace, its masonry to about 16.5 m and its slated spire to the printed 90 ft (27.4 m). Openings are the draft's sash in rows, not the church's, which are T-3014's. The seed 72272670 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %. Liberty L-draft-district-background-3009.

draft.note: The draft's own provenance: the pass that wrote it, the rows it read and the tickets that replace it attribute by attribute under this id.
